title: Don Lemon Accuses Justice Dept. of Vindictive Prosecution in Church Protest Case
summary: Lawyers for the former CNN anchor asked a judge to throw out the case, saying prosecutors had “acted on the president’s animus by filing unprecedented charges against a journalist for doing his job.”
